dict.string: Codealong opens terminal sessions in Ghostty, iTerm2 or Terminal and brings the right window to the front.
Codealong turns what you say into text for the session you're talking to, on this Mac. No audio is kept.
Codealong reads your calendar to offer to take notes as a meeting starts, and to name the meeting and who's in it in those notes. It changes nothing in it.
Codealong turns what a meeting says into text for the session you asked to listen, on this Mac. No audio is kept.
